module Assembly
  Geometry = Data.define(:length, :cosine, :sine, :dofs)
  Properties = Data.define(:area, :inertia, :young, :yield_stress, :density, :expansion, :stiffness)
  Loading = Data.define(:external, :total, :temperature, :settlement)

  def self.member_geometry(nodes, members, node_dofs)
    members.map do |member|
      start, finish = nodes[member.start], nodes[member.finish]
      dx, dy = finish.x - start.x, finish.y - start.y
      length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
      Geometry.new(length, dx / length, dy / length, node_dofs[member.start] + node_dofs[member.finish])
    end
  end

  def self.member_properties(model, choices, geometry)
    model.members.zip(choices, geometry).map do |member, choice, shape|
      section, material = model.sections[choice], model.materials[member.material]
      Properties.new(section.area, section.inertia, material.young, material.yield_stress,
                     material.density, material.expansion, material.young * section.area / shape.length)
    end
  end

  def self.member_weight(properties, geometry)
    properties.density * 9.81 * properties.area * geometry.length / 1_000_000_000
  end

  def self.member_stiffness(properties, geometry)
    k, c, s = properties.stiffness, geometry.cosine, geometry.sine
    xx, xy, yy = k * (c * c), k * (c * s), k * (s * s)
    [[xx, xy, -xx, -xy], [xy, yy, -xy, -yy], [-xx, -xy, xx, xy], [-xy, -yy, xy, yy]]
  end

  def self.assemble(geometry, properties, degrees, removed = nil)
    matrix = Array.new(degrees) { Array.new(degrees, 0.0) }
    geometry.zip(properties).each_with_index do |(shape, member), number|
      next if number == removed

      local = member_stiffness(member, shape)
      shape.dofs.each_with_index do |global_row, row|
        shape.dofs.each_with_index { |global_column, column| matrix[global_row][global_column] += local[row][column] }
      end
    end
    matrix
  end

  def self.load_vectors(case_definition, geometry, properties, node_dofs, degrees, removed = nil)
    external, thermal = Array.new(degrees, 0.0), Array.new(degrees, 0.0)
    temperature, settlement = Array.new(geometry.length, 0.0), false
    case_definition.lines.each do |line|
      case line[0]
      when 'FORCE'
        _, node, horizontal, vertical = line
        x, y = node_dofs[node]
        external[x] += horizontal * 1000
        external[y] += vertical * 1000
      when 'TEMPERATURE'
        _, number, change = line
        next if number == removed

        member, shape = properties[number], geometry[number]
        force = member.young * member.area * member.expansion * change
        temperature[number] = force
        direction = [-shape.cosine, -shape.sine, shape.cosine, shape.sine]
        shape.dofs.zip(direction).each { |degree, coefficient| thermal[degree] += force * coefficient }
      when 'SELFWEIGHT'
        properties.zip(geometry).each_with_index do |(member, shape), number|
          next if number == removed

          weight = member_weight(member, shape)
          external[shape.dofs[1]] -= weight / 2
          external[shape.dofs[3]] -= weight / 2
        end
      when 'SETTLEMENT'
        settlement = true
      end
    end
    Loading.new(external, external.zip(thermal).map { |first, second| first + second }, temperature, settlement)
  end
end

module Design
  PI = 3.141592653589793

  def self.buckling(properties, geometry, inertia = properties.inertia)
    PI * PI * properties.young * inertia / (geometry.length * geometry.length)
  end

  def self.utilization(force, properties, geometry, section = nil)
    area, inertia = section ? [section.area, section.inertia] : [properties.area, properties.inertia]
    [(force / area).abs / properties.yield_stress, [0, -force].max / buckling(properties, geometry, inertia)].max
  end

  def self.slenderness(properties, geometry, section = nil)
    area, inertia = section ? [section.area, section.inertia] : [properties.area, properties.inertia]
    geometry.length / Math.sqrt(inertia / area)
  end

  def self.slenderness_limit(number, combinations, limits)
    combinations.any? { |result| result.forces[number].negative? } ? limits[0] : limits[1]
  end

  def self.select_section(members, sections, properties, geometry, combinations, limits)
    sections.each_with_index do |section, number|
      acceptable = members.all? do |member|
        slenderness(properties[member], geometry[member], section) <= limits[member] &&
          combinations.all? do |result|
            utilization(result.forces[member], properties[member], geometry[member], section) <= 1
          end
      end
      return number if acceptable
    end
    sections.length - 1
  end
end

module ModelIO
  Node = Data.define(:identifier, :x, :y)
  Member = Data.define(:identifier, :start, :finish, :section, :material, :group)
  Section = Data.define(:name, :area, :inertia)
  Material = Data.define(:name, :young, :yield_stress, :density, :expansion)
  Support = Data.define(:node, :fixed, :prescribed)
  LoadCase = Data.define(:name, :lines)
  Combination = Data.define(:name, :terms)
  Model = Data.define(:nodes, :members, :sections, :materials, :supports, :cases, :combinations, :settings)

  def self.csv_rows(name)
    File.readlines("input/#{name}.csv", chomp: true).drop(1).map { |line| line.split(',') }
  end

  def self.read_loads(node_index, member_index)
    cases, combinations, loads, name = [], [], [], nil
    File.foreach('input/loads.txt', chomp: true) do |line|
      kind, *values = line.split
      case kind
      when 'LOADCASE'
        name, loads = values[0], []
      when 'END'
        cases << LoadCase.new(name, loads)
      when 'COMBINATION'
        terms = values.drop(1).each_slice(2).map { |case_name, factor| [case_name, factor.to_f] }
        combinations << Combination.new(values[0], terms)
      when 'FORCE'
        loads << [kind, node_index.fetch(values[0].to_i), values[1].to_f, values[2].to_f]
      when 'TEMPERATURE'
        loads << [kind, member_index.fetch(values[0].to_i), values[1].to_f]
      else
        loads << [kind]
      end
    end
    [cases, combinations]
  end

  def self.read_settings(node_index, member_index)
    settings = { 'influence' => [], 'drawing' => [] }
    File.foreach('input/params.txt', chomp: true) do |line|
      kind, *values = line.split
      case kind
      when 'deck'
        settings[kind] = values.map { |value| node_index.fetch(value.to_i) }
      when 'influence'
        settings[kind] << member_index.fetch(values[0].to_i)
      when 'vehicle'
        settings[kind] = [values[0].to_i, values.drop(1).each_slice(2).map { |offset, load| [offset.to_i, load.to_f] }]
      when 'rating'
        settings[kind] = [values[0], values[1].to_f, values[2].to_f]
      when 'slenderness'
        settings[kind] = values.map(&:to_f)
      when 'deflection'
        settings[kind] = [values[0], values[1].to_i]
      when 'vibration'
        settings[kind] = [values[0], values[1].to_i, values[2].to_i]
      when 'removal'
        settings[kind] = values[0]
      when 'drawing'
        settings[kind] << [values[0], *values.drop(1).map(&:to_i)]
      when 'utilization_map'
        settings[kind] = values.map(&:to_i)
      end
    end
    settings
  end

  def self.read_model
    nodes = csv_rows('nodes').map { |row| Node.new(*row.map(&:to_i)) }
    sections = csv_rows('sections').map { |name, area, inertia| Section.new(name, area.to_f, inertia.to_f) }
    materials = csv_rows('materials').map { |row| Material.new(row[0], *row.drop(1).map(&:to_f)) }
    node_index = nodes.each_with_index.to_h { |node, index| [node.identifier, index] }
    section_index = sections.each_with_index.to_h { |section, index| [section.name, index] }
    material_index = materials.each_with_index.to_h { |material, index| [material.name, index] }
    members = csv_rows('members').map do |id, start, finish, section, material, group|
      Member.new(id.to_i, node_index.fetch(start.to_i), node_index.fetch(finish.to_i),
                 section_index.fetch(section), material_index.fetch(material), group)
    end
    member_index = members.each_with_index.to_h { |member, index| [member.identifier, index] }
    supports = csv_rows('supports').map do |node, fix_x, fix_y, dx, dy|
      Support.new(node_index.fetch(node.to_i), [fix_x.to_i, fix_y.to_i], [dx.to_f, dy.to_f])
    end
    cases, combinations = read_loads(node_index, member_index)
    Model.new(nodes, members, sections, materials, supports, cases, combinations, read_settings(node_index, member_index))
  end
end

module Postprocess
  Result = Data.define(:name, :displacement, :forces, :reactions, :external)

  def self.axial_forces(geometry, properties, displacement, temperature, removed = nil)
    forces = Array.new(geometry.length, 0.0)
    geometry.zip(properties).each_with_index do |(shape, member), number|
      next if number == removed

      ix, iy, jx, jy = shape.dofs
      extension = (displacement[jx] - displacement[ix]) * shape.cosine +
                  (displacement[jy] - displacement[iy]) * shape.sine
      forces[number] = member.stiffness * extension - temperature[number]
    end
    forces
  end

  def self.reactions(matrix, displacement, force, restrained)
    result = Array.new(force.length, 0.0)
    restrained.each do |row|
      value = 0.0
      force.length.times { |column| value += matrix[row][column] * displacement[column] }
      result[row] = value - force[row]
    end
    result
  end

  def self.superpose(combination, results)
    name, factor = combination.terms.first
    fields = %i[displacement forces reactions external]
    vectors = fields.map { |field| results[name].public_send(field).map { |value| factor * value } }
    combination.terms.drop(1).each do |case_name, coefficient|
      vectors.zip(fields.map { |field| results[case_name].public_send(field) }).each do |target, source|
        source.each_with_index { |value, index| target[index] += coefficient * value }
      end
    end
    Result.new(combination.name, *vectors)
  end

  def self.equilibrium_residual(result, geometry)
    residual = result.external.zip(result.reactions).map { |external, reaction| external + reaction }
    geometry.zip(result.forces).each do |shape, force|
      direction = [shape.cosine, shape.sine, -shape.cosine, -shape.sine]
      shape.dofs.zip(direction).each { |degree, coefficient| residual[degree] += force * coefficient }
    end
    residual.map(&:abs).max
  end
end

module Solver
  def self.cholesky(matrix, free)
    size = matrix.length
    lower = Array.new(size) { Array.new(size, 0.0) }
    size.times do |row|
      (0..row).each do |column|
        value = matrix[row][column]
        column.times { |index| value -= lower[row][index] * lower[column][index] }
        if column < row
          lower[row][column] = value / lower[column][column]
        else
          return [nil, free[row]] if value <= 0.000000001 * matrix[row][row]

          lower[row][row] = Math.sqrt(value)
        end
      end
    end
    [lower, nil]
  end

  def self.solve(lower, right)
    size = right.length
    intermediate, result = Array.new(size, 0.0), Array.new(size, 0.0)
    size.times do |row|
      value = right[row]
      row.times { |column| value -= lower[row][column] * intermediate[column] }
      intermediate[row] = value / lower[row][row]
    end
    (size - 1).downto(0) do |row|
      value = intermediate[row]
      ((row + 1)...size).each { |column| value -= lower[column][row] * result[column] }
      result[row] = value / lower[row][row]
    end
    result
  end
end
